participation.context: Read the two bills, and did not cross.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the post twice for the new title beside your own. You left both bills where they were.

title: Read Two Gentlemen and Crack Me This Nut

participation.context: Looked at the post. His face is not in it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You saw the two sheets. You walked on without either of them.

title: Saw the two sheets and walked on
